Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the registration of charitable organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to registration of charitable organizations; andamending RCW 19.09.085.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.09.085 and 2007 c 471 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Registration under this chapter shall be effective for one yearor longer, as established by the secretary, for any charitableorganization raising one hundred thousand dollars or more during anaccounting year. Registration under this chapter is effective forthree years for any charitable organization raising less than onehundred thousand dollars during an accounting year. (2) Any charitable organization with a threeyear registrationshall notify the secretary when they reasonably anticipate raising morethan one hundred thousand dollars during an accounting year, and thesecretary may revaluate the registration requirements under subsection(1) of this section. (3) Reregistration required under RCW 19.09.075 or 19.09.079 shallbe submitted to the secretary no later than the date established by thesecretary by rule. p. 1 SB 5164 (((3))) (4) Entities required to register under this chapter shallfile a notice of change of information within thirty days of any changein the information contained in RCW 19.09.075 (1) through (9) or19.09.079 (1) through (7). (((4))) (5) The secretary shall notify entities registered underthis chapter of the need to reregister upon the expiration of theircurrent registration. The notification shall be by mail, sent at leastsixty days prior to the expiration of their current registration.Failure to register shall not be excused by a failure of the secretaryto mail the notice or by an entity's failure to receive the notice.
